fine_lines.title: -er/-est vs more/most
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصفات القصيرة (مقطع واحد، أو مقطعان تنتهي بـ y) تأخذ -er و-est: slow → slower → slowest، pricey → pricier → priciest. الصفات الطويلة تأخذ more و most: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Short adjectives (one syllable, or two ending in y) add -er/-est: slow, slower, slowest; pricey, pricier, priciest. Long adjectives use more/most: more expensive, the most expensive.

examples.sentence: The sea trip is pricier than the mountain trip.
A plane ticket is more expensive than a bus ticket.

fine_lines.title: good / better / best
fine_lines.explanation_ar: صفات غير قياسية: good → better (للمقارنة بين شيئين) → the best (الأفضل بين الكل). ومثلها bad → worse → the worst.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Irregular: good → better (two things) → the best (all things). Also bad → worse → the worst.

examples.sentence: A beach is better than an office.
This is the best vacation ever.

expressions.meaning_en: High places make me feel fear.

You got the prize? You deserve it!

grammar.title: Comparative and superlative adjectives
grammar.explanation_ar: الصفة المقارنة (comparative) نقارن بها بين شيئين، وتأتي بعدها than: Planes are scarier than trains. صفة التفضيل (superlative) تعني أن شيئًا واحدًا هو الأكثر بين الكل، وقبلها the: the scariest. القواعد: صفة قصيرة + er/est (slow → slower → the slowest). صفة تنتهي بـ y: نحوّل y إلى i (pricey → pricier → the priciest). صفة طويلة: more/the most (more comfortable, the most expensive). وهناك صفات شاذة: good → better → best، bad → worse → worst.
grammar.explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things and use than: Helicopters are scarier than planes. Superlatives show one thing is the most of all and use the: the scariest. Short adjectives: -er/-est. Ending in y: change y to i (pricier, priciest). Long adjectives: more/most. Irregular: good-better-best, bad-worse-worst.
examples: A beach is much better than here.
The Deep Sea Adventure is pricier than the Mountain Getaway.
The Safari Camp Out is our priciest vacation.
Biking is the slowest and least comfortable way to travel.

questions.question: Helicopters are ____ than planes.
questions.explanation_ar: للمقارنة بين شيئين نستخدم scarier + than.

questions.question: This is the ____ vacation of all time!
questions.explanation_ar: صفة التفضيل من good هي the best.
questions.explanation_en: The superlative of good is the best.

questions.question: The comparative of 'pricey' is:
questions.explanation_ar: نحوّل y إلى i ونضيف er: pricier.
questions.explanation_en: Change y to i and add -er: pricier.

questions.question: The opposite of 'better' is:
questions.explanation_ar: bad → worse → worst. فـ worse عكس better.
questions.explanation_en: bad - worse - worst. Worse is the opposite of better.

questions.question: A trip to see wild animals like lions is a ____.
